motivation: The frozen 16-history confirmation of a prior-selfing versus pollen-discount mutational-order sign contrast FAILED. The original priority schedules supplied new mutation for 400 updates to the first-access trait and 250 updates to the second; a duration confound was identified before this new balanced design.
mutational_access_rule: The total number of updates with mutational supply is exactly 250 for both I and A and identical across all four schedules. Already inherited variation can continue to be selected and segregated while further mutation supply is closed; no trait-expression reset.
founders: Identical 48 genotypes per group, matching/access standing variation retained, I and A both fixed to 0.5 at t0.
primary_pilot_estimand: Paired far-pre minus near-pre poststress occupancy contrast, averaged across two post-visitor regimes × four budgets for each schedule, then assurance_first minus investment_first; report all settings and history-level contrasts and controls.
reporting: Exploratory; no confirmatory gate, no CI or multi-run parameter tuning. Include the independent16 original-access failure in reporting.
boundaries: Equal total mutation-access updates fixes only duration of mutational supply, not equal time under selection after each mutation
This does not directly force observed phenotypic transition order
The 4 visitor histories, nested repeats and outcome-informed stress grid cannot validate ecological generality
No natural-island calibration, no direct island extirpation or rescue inference
Any apparent positive/negative setting effect must be independently checked with new histories
Previously failed independent16 gate must stay failed and must not be rebranded
